messages:
maria: ok team — planning thread for the "gradual exposure" rollout of per-customer routing profiles. goal: allow customers to opt into predictive routing with safe quick-exit if quality or cost regressions appear. :dart:
alex: high-level asks: define launch criteria (quality delta, latency P95, cost per token), clear kill-switches, and a short canary plan. how conservative do we want to be?
lee: proposing phased exposure: 0.5% -> 2% -> 10% -> 30% over 48h windows, with automatic pause if any metric breaches. variants: control (current routing), v1 (predictive routing, no kv-cache changes), v2 (predictive + cache warm). A/B test for quality.
samir: from infra side, we can attach a feature flag scope by customer id and region. flag pattern: feature.predictive_routing.{customer|region}.{variant}. example toggle API:```bash
curl -X POST https://flags.redwood.internal/v1/toggles \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $FLAG_KEY' \n  -d '{"flag":"feature.predictive_routing.customer.acme","state":"on","percent":2}'
```
ops-bot: canary-run started by samir at 2025-11-15T14:00Z — initial slice: 0.5% global, region eu-west-1 excluded by default.
eva: +1 on conservative. also need an enterprise opt-out flow: a few customers explicitly asked to be excluded from any experiements, ensure their tenant IDs are whitelisted.
alex: launch criteria proposal:
- quality regression vs control <= 0.8% (measured by production eval set + manual spot checks)
- latency P95 not worse than +15%
- error rate (5xx+client failures) delta <= 0.1% absolute
- cost per 1k tokens not above baseline by >10%
if any of those breach, pause rollout and auto-rollback after 5 minutes if engineering doesn't ack. :rotating_light:
product-qa: add these automated sanity checks to our canary dashboard. sample PromQL for p95 latency alert:
```
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_latency_bucket[5m])) by (le)) > baseline_p95 * 1.15
```
product-qa: also plan short manual prompt set evals after each stage (10 seed prompts from QA + 5 customer examples).
lee: for fast fallback we should support two modes: soft-fallback (route only new sessions back to control) and hard-kill (full flag off). implement preference: soft by default, hard if repeated breaches.
samir: implement circuit-breaker with cooldown: when threshold met, set flag percent=0 and annotate incident ticket automatically: `/toggle --flag feature.predictive_routing.* --set 0 --reason "auto-fallback: metric breach"`
alex: need clear SLO ownership: product = qualitative threshold, eng = latency/errors, infra = toggles/ops-runbook. assignable owners?
maria: owners: product=maria, infra=samir, qa=product-qa, eng=lee. action items:
- samir: stub toggle API and circuit-breaker runbook (by EOD Wed)
- product-qa: add canary dashboard alerts + prompt set (by Thu)
- lee: implement variant routing code and soft-fallback path (by next Tues)
- eva: confirm enterprise opt-outs list and share with samir (by Tue noon)
please add any missing checks. :thumbsup:
